args.title: Double charge on capture retry after card network timeout (missing idempotency key)
args.body:
## Summary
Customers are being charged twice when the card network times out during checkout and our capture is retried. The retry path in `retry.py` does not carry the idempotency key across the second attempt, so the network treats the retry as a new capture.

## Repro
1. Start a checkout.
2. Force / encounter a card network timeout on capture.
3. Retry is issued automatically.
4. Two captures land on the customer's card.

## Impact
Approximately 40 orders/day affected (per @maya).

## Root cause
`retry.py` does not persist or propagate the idempotency key to the retried capture attempt.

## Proposed fix
Persist the idempotency key **before** the first capture, and reuse it on all retries. Confirmed reproducible in staging by @jordan; a fix is reportedly in PR #481.

## Source
Filed from the discussion in Slack `#payments`, thread `18291` (root message by @maya).
